notes.title: New trailer announcing Xbox version
notes.notes:
Hey there!

We're working really hard on polishing Weakless right now. The game is almost finished, few tweaks remaining and mostly bug fixing, but we're glad we'll finally be able to share our game with whole world soon.

[previewyoutube=QM-aRknTHPo;full][/previewyoutube]

Xbox version is coming to the market with PC version - it's been few weeks we knew that, but we had to test few things and wait for the right moment.
